What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

In simple terms, a sovereign digital commerce stack refers to a custom-built infrastructure that allows designers to sell digital products directly to customers without relying on third-party platforms. This means you own your entire sales process, from product delivery to payment processing, without any middlemen taking a cut. The benefits are clear: lower fees, greater control, and the ability to reach customers in even the most restrictive markets.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer. This level of transparency and verifiability is structurally different from conventional payment processors, where transaction data is owned by the platform and subject to their record-keeping policies.
